changes.comment: feat(refine): ore-tour gains bind(controller) - one call renders a beacon handle's current snapshot into the card's props and routes next/back/skip/finish/dismiss back into it; auto presentation now freezes per open so a mid-step resize never rebuilds a live card; the card re-asserts focus when a step change rebuilds its content; the spotlight cutout measures element anchors live and follows them on scroll and resize; exports OreTourElement, TourController and TourStepSnapshot for typed host access
